units.source_text: 夜色将近黎明之时，四周沉寂，气象清幽。

en.t: As night was nearing dawn, all around was silent, and the air was pure and serene.
When the picture contest was over, they opened the banquet and drank together.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣一面把盏，一面纵谈往事，对帅皇子说道：“我自幼耽好学问。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji held his cup while speaking freely of the past, and said to Prince Sochi, "From childhood I was deeply fond of learning.

units.source_text: 大约父皇预料我的才能将来略能伸展，所以有一次训诫我道：‘才能与学问，世人过分尊重。

en.t: Perhaps my imperial father foresaw that my talents might one day develop a little, and so he once admonished me, saying, 'Talent and learning are valued too highly by people of the world.

units.source_text: 恐是因此之故，才学高深之人，能兼备寿命与福分者，实甚少有。

en.t: Perhaps for that reason, among people of profound talent and learning, those who possess both long life and good fortune are truly very few.

units.source_text: 汝今生长富贵之家，即使无才无学，亦不劣于他人，所以不须深入此道。’

en.t: You have now been born and raised in a house of wealth and rank; even without talent or learning, you will be no worse than others, so you need not go deeply into this path.'

units.source_text: 因此父皇不教我修习学问，只教我玩弄技艺。

en.t: For that reason, my imperial father did not teach me to pursue scholarship, but only had me amuse myself with the arts.

units.source_text: 我于技艺，虽然不算笨拙，但并无特别专长。

en.t: As for the arts, although I could not be called clumsy, I had no particular specialty.

units.source_text: 惟绘画一道，虽乃雕虫小技，我却常想设法磨练，务求其能画得如意称心。

en.t: Only in the art of painting, though it is but a minor skill, did I constantly try to find ways to polish myself, striving to paint exactly as I wished.

units.source_text: 想不到后来做了渔樵之人，亲眼看到了各处海边的真情实景，历尽无遗地观察了种种风物。

en.t: Unexpectedly, later I became like a fisherman or woodcutter, saw with my own eyes the true scenes along many seashores, and observed all kinds of landscapes and customs without omission.

units.source_text: 然而笔力有限，不能随心所欲地表达其深奥的风趣。

en.t: Yet my brush has its limits, and I cannot express their profound charm as freely as I wish.

units.source_text: 因此倘无机缘，不敢出以示人。

en.t: Therefore, unless there were some occasion, I did not dare bring them out to show anyone.

units.source_text: 今日贸然请教，深恐世人将讥我为好事耳。”

en.t: Today I have rashly presented them for your judgment, but I deeply fear that people will mock me as merely meddlesome."
